outcome: Rate of caesarean sections before labor for non-reassuring fetal heart rate
cohort: 245 fetuses with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) born between 2015 and 2017 at the Femme Mère Enfant Hospital (Lyon, France)
finding: The standardized healthcare pathway resulted in a higher rate of minimum evidence-based care (MEC) compared to the traditional pathway for both early- and late-onset IUGR.
mod_finding: The standardized healthcare pathway led to a reduction in the rate of cesarean sections before labor for non-reassuring fetal heart rate compared to the traditional pathway.
